abstract: INTRODUCTION: We present the case of a newborn with sacrococcygeal teratoma and complex gastroschisis, complicated with intestinal perforation. This is an unusual association, with only 1 reported case worldwide, and this is the first reported case that survived with a good outcome. CLINICAL CASE: The treatment was conducted in 4 stages: gastroschisis closure and enterostomy delaying the treatment of the atresia, teratoma resection, correction of the atresia using the Santulli technique and closure of the stoma. It took 6 months and 18 days to complete the whole treatment. The patient showed excellent progress with good growth and subsequent development. DISCUSSION: The treatment conducted in 4 stages made possible the resolution of each pathology, with proper assessment and surgical planning, making possible the patient's development and growth while minimizing the risks of complications.
abstract_ja: はじめに：複雑性腹壁破裂に腸管穿孔を合併した仙尾部奇形腫の新生児例を報告する。この併存は世界で1例しか報告がなく、良好な転帰で生存した初めての症例である。症例：治療は4段階で行った。すなわち、腹壁破裂の閉鎖と腸瘻造設（腸閉鎖の治療は遅延）、奇形腫切除、Santulli法による腸閉鎖症の修復、ストーマ閉鎖である。治療全体に6か月18日を要した。患児は良好な発育と発達を示した。考察：4段階の治療により各病変を解決でき、適切な評価と手術計画によって、合併症のリスクを抑えつつ発育と成長を可能にした。
